mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my bathroom for a shower or tub upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your shower or tub upgrade project begins, it's helpful to clear out personal items from the bathroom, including toiletries, towels, and decorations. Ensure clear access to the work area for our team and protect any items in adjacent rooms that might be affected by dust or foot traffic. Discuss with our team any specific access needs or concerns you have regarding your property. This preparation helps ensure a smooth and efficient start to the renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your bathroom by clearing personal items and ensuring clear access for our team. Protect adjacent areas from dust and foot traffic, and discuss any concerns with us.
